description: Controlled, non-private workloads for the OLMoE real-routing M1 study.

workloads.prompt: Explain how asynchronous expert prefetch can hide memory-transfer latency in a sparse mixture-of-experts model.
Spiega in modo tecnico come una cache gerarchica GPU, RAM e NVMe puo servire gli esperti di un modello mixture-of-experts.
Write a concise Python function that computes the Jaccard similarity of two sets, then explain its complexity.
A cache holds 128 experts and each token selects 8 experts. Derive the expected hit count when the independent hit probability is 0.75.
Translate 'memory bandwidth' into Italian. Next, give a Rust ownership rule. Finally, factor 221 and name a Baroque composer.
